A '''drone''' was a member of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who served as a [[Shaper caste|shaper]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], it at one [[Time/Legends|time]] reported to [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] about the process of the conversion of [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], though its mumbling and exhaustive report soon bored the [[Warrior caste|warrior]], prompting [[Nom Anor]] to explain while the drone left the room hurriedly.
